ChatConversation.title: ChatConversation
ChatConversation.description: A user-owned AI chat conversation thread in E-Ishlar-Max.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the conversation owner.

title.description: Short display title of the chat conversation.

modelId.description: Selected Gemini or Offline model identifier.

messageCount.description: Total number of messages in the conversation.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when conversation was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when conversation was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

ChatMessage.description: An individual message inside a user's conversation.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the message owner.

modelId.description: Model identifier used for this message.

attachmentUri.description: Optional local URI or reference path.

groundingUrls.description: Bounded list (max 10) of grounded web/maps URLs.

mapsPlaceNames.description: Bounded list (max 10) of grounded Google Maps place labels.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when message was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).
